text: In crates/athena-cli/src/backtest.rs, D87 is now correctly under review on the real records, citing only ar1x through its derived host-error record, but no introspection record is built: introspection_for takes only a fired run's intervention events, and the host-error run's evidence is a derived record. Root cause: the introspection is tied to one kind of evidence instead of to whatever fired. Build the introspection record from the earliest valid citation of whichever signal fired (for a derived record, from its source intervention), and make the backtest report a finding when a decision is put under review with no introspection record. Verify with fixture records that copy ar1x exactly (the real run comes after landing).
